plan.title: Gender Performance Comparison
plan.subtitle: Comparison of performance improvements between girls and boys

panels.title: Average Shuttle Run Improvement by Gender
panels.sql: WITH baseline_avg AS (SELECT "Gender", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_baseline FROM baseline GROUP BY 1), endline_avg AS (SELECT "Gender", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_endline FROM endline GROUP BY 1) SELECT b."Gender", (e.avg_endline - b.avg_baseline) AS improvement FROM baseline_avg b JOIN endline_avg e ON b."Gender" = e."Gender" ORDER BY 2

panels.title: Average Sit Ups Improvement by Gender
panels.sql: WITH baseline_avg AS (SELECT "Gender", AVG("Sit ups") AS avg_baseline FROM baseline GROUP BY 1), endline_avg AS (SELECT "Gender", AVG("Sit ups") AS avg_endline FROM endline GROUP BY 1) SELECT b."Gender", (e.avg_endline - b.avg_baseline) AS improvement FROM baseline_avg b JOIN endline_avg e ON b."Gender" = e."Gender" ORDER BY 2

plan.narrative: The dashboard compares the performance improvements between girls and boys in two key areas: shuttle run times and sit-ups. The first panel shows the average improvement in shuttle run times, while the second panel displays the average improvement in sit-ups. Each panel uses a bar chart to illustrate the difference in performance improvements between genders, with the improvement calculated as the difference between the average endline and baseline scores. This analysis helps in understanding whether girls and boys are improving equally in these physical activities.
